_meta.source: FFIEC HMDA Public Loan/Application Register data fields (2018+), https://ffiec.cfpb.gov/documentation/publications/loan-level-datasets/lar-data-fields
_meta.note: Domain knowledge external to the data, used only when dataset_options.glossary is true. Definitions and code labels follow the official data dictionary; entries marked 'paraphrased' were paraphrased on the retrieved page. Applied to each column and to its *_name label column.

hoepa_status.definition: Whether the covered loan is a high-cost mortgage

rate_spread.definition: The difference between the covered loan's annual percentage rate (APR) and the average prime offer rate (APOR) for a comparable transaction as of the date the interest rate is set

total_points_and_fees.definition: The total points and fees, in dollars, charged in connection with the covered loan

prepayment_penalty_term.definition: The term, in months, of any prepayment penalty

loan_term.definition: The number of months after which the legal obligation will mature or terminate, or would have matured or terminated

intro_rate_period.definition: The number of months until the first date the interest rate may change after closing or account opening (proposed number for applications)

balloon_payment.definition: Whether the contractual terms include, or would have included, a balloon payment

negative_amortization.definition: Whether the contractual terms include, or would have included, a term that would cause the covered loan to be a negative amortization loan

interest_only_payment.definition: Whether the contractual terms include, or would have included, interest-only payments

other_nonamortizing_features.definition: Whether the contractual terms include, or would have included, any term, other than negative amortization, interest-only payments, or balloon payments, that would allow for payments other than fully amortizing payments

open_end_line_of_credit.definition: Whether the covered loan or application is for an open-end line of credit

codes.2: Not an open-end line of credit

business_or_commercial_purpose.definition: Whether the covered loan or application is primarily for a business or commercial purpose

codes.1: Primarily for a business or commercial purpose
codes.2: Not primarily for a business or commercial purpose

reverse_mortgage.definition: Whether the covered loan or application is for a reverse mortgage

manufactured_home_secured_property_type.definition: Whether the covered loan is, or would have been, secured by a manufactured home and land, or by a manufactured home and not land

lien_status.definition: Lien status of the property securing the covered loan, or in the case of an application, proposed to secure the covered loan

loan_amount.definition: The amount of the covered loan, or the amount applied for

conforming_loan_limit.definition: Indicates whether the reported loan amount exceeds the GSE (government sponsored enterprise) conforming loan limit

action_taken.definition: The action taken on the covered loan or application

codes.8: Preapproval request approved but not accepted

loan_purpose.definition: The purpose of covered loan or application

loan_type.definition: The type of covered loan or application

codes.1: Conventional (not insured or guaranteed by FHA, VA, RHS, or FSA)
codes.4: USDA Rural Housing Service or Farm Service Agency guaranteed (RHS or FSA)

total_loan_costs.definition: The amount, in dollars, of total loan costs

discount_points.definition: The points paid, in dollars, to the creditor to reduce the interest rate

lender_credits.definition: The amount, in dollars, of lender credits

origination_charges.definition: The total of all itemized amounts, in dollars, that are designated borrower-paid at or before closing

interest_rate.definition: The interest rate for the covered loan or application

debt_to_income_ratio.definition: The ratio, as a percentage, of the applicant's or borrower's total monthly debt to the total monthly income relied on in making the credit decision

combined_loan_to_value_ratio.definition: The ratio of the total amount of debt secured by the property to the value of the property relied on in making the credit decision

property_value.definition: The value of the property securing the covered loan or, in the case of an application, proposed to secure the covered loan, relied on in making the credit decision
